competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times with a whirling storm of fire. Stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 60% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Shoots two arrows to attack a target enemy and a random enemy and stuns them with a 50% chance each. Guarantees to stun the enemy if both arrows hit the same target.

effets.description: Bypasses all enemy resistances when applying effects.
effets.note: For stun, if all hits go into one enemy

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
effets.note: 100% if 2nd hit goes to the same enemy

competences.description: Shoots a flurry of arrows, attacking all enemies 4 - 6 times. Each attack has a 20% chance to remove a beneficial effect and reduce their Attack Speed for 2 turns.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
